description: Upload an existing image to this presentation's Supabase Storage folder. Use the returned public URL as an image src in the slide DSL. After HTTP 429, wait and retry with the same operation_id and arguments.

image_data.description: Base64 data URI for a PNG, JPEG or WebP image, up to 10 MiB and 20 megapixels.
image_data.title: Image Data

operation_id.description: Account-wide operation ID, 1–128 characters after trimming. Reuse only for an identical retry.
operation_id.title: Operation Id

name: upload_image
